sentences.text:
Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 3513 of 2023
Applicant :- Badami @ Vashishth Yadav
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh Kumar Mishra

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
None has appeared on behalf of the informant despite service of notice.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 606 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C., 3(2)(v), 3(1)w(ii) SC/ST Act and 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Dhanghata, District Sant Kabir Nagar, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant/accused that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Alleged incident has been shown of 08.10.2022 but F.I.R. has been lodged on 25.10.2022.

The victim has stated her age as 18 years and that in her statement under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., victim has clearly stated that she was having love affair with the applicant and that on 08.10.2022, she has gone with the applicant to Punjab with her own free will Badami @ Vashishth Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147389842/
1 and they have married each other.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per High School certificate, the age of victim was shown only a few days less than 18 years but in her statement, she has clearly stated that she is a major girl.
Referring to the facts of the matter, it was submitted that no case is made out against the applicant.

Lastly, it is submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 25.11.2022 having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant Badami @ Vashishth Yadav involved in aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2.The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3.The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

5.The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 Suraj  Badami @ Vashishth Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147389842/
